name: gpui-vue-monorepo
description: Native GPU-accelerated Vue 3 renderer for Zed's GPUI

scripts.build: bun run build:native && bun --filter @gpui-native/vue build && bun --filter '@gpui-vue/example-*' build
scripts.build:binaries: bun run build:native && bun --filter @gpui-native/vue build && bun --filter '@gpui-vue/example-*' build:binary
scripts.bench: bun run scripts/bench-hot-paths.mts && cargo run --release -p gpui-vue-core --example bench_hot_paths
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo check --workspace --all-features
scripts.lint: oxlint --vue-plugin --deny-warnings packages/gpui-vue/src packages/gpui-vue/test examples web scripts vite.examples.config.mts vite.pages.config.mts
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --vue-plugin --fix packages/gpui-vue/src packages/gpui-vue/test examples web scripts vite.examples.config.mts vite.pages.config.mts
scripts.typecheck: bun --filter @gpui-native/vue typecheck && bun --filter '@gpui-vue/example-*' typecheck && bun packages/gpui-vue/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json
